mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL annualized growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the past 6 months signals strengthening demand in the economy, which positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 45% of instances when HOUST increases by more than 5% over 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 5% year-over-year and industrial production (INDPRO) grows by more than 3% year-over-year, it signals robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS YoY growth > 5% and INDPRO YoY growth > 3%
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when both RSAFS and INDPRO meet their respective growth thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 25 basis points over the past 3 months signals a loosening monetary policy, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS decreases by more than 25bps over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the past month signals a strengthening labor market, which leads to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over the past 6 months signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO decreases by more than 2% over 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3 percentage points over the past 3 months, it signals a robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 QoQ growth > 2% and UNRATE decreases > 0.3pp in 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when both GDPC1 and UNRATE meet their respective growth and decline thresholds.
